statements.status_notes: GHSA-5q95-hrpc-m3w3 (CVE-2026-77420) is a local ReDoS in JLine DefaultHistory.matchPatterns() when the history-ignore reader variable is a crafted regular expression. See https://github.com/jline/jline3/security/advisories/GHSA-5q95-hrpc-m3w3. jline-reader 3.21.0 returns from matchPatterns before compiling a pattern when history-ignore is empty. The image includes cypher-shell, which can be invoked and which uses DefaultHistory, but cypher-shell never sets history-ignore. Neo4j 5.26.30 and 2026.09.0 only set the history file path, the secondary prompt, and the disable-history and disable-completion flags (https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/blob/5.26.30/community/cypher-shell/cypher-shell/src/main/java/org/neo4j/shell/terminal/JlineTerminal.java). jline-reader does not load history-ignore from the environment, system properties, or a config file. The advisory proof of concept is the JLine console command set history-ignore, and cypher-shell does not provide that command: it depends only on jline-reader and jline-terminal and parses input as Cypher. The neo4j server process does not call JLine. The regex path therefore does not run when the server starts or when cypher-shell is invoked.

jline is bundled for the interactive Gremlin console (jline-remote-telnet); the telnet server is not started by the default gremlin-server runtime. Upgrading to jline 4.x is a major bump; reachability assessment pending.
